item.title: Tye Trujillo Pushes OTTTO Into a New Era With the "Sweaty Pool" EP
item.description: OTTTO returns with "Sweaty Pool," a new EP marking a fresh era for Tye Trujillo and the band, featuring a collaboration with Nick Oliveri.

item.title: Ernest Tibbs and Simon Phillips Showcase Tight Rhythm Work on “You Can’t But You Can” at Little Big Beat Studio
item.description: Ernest Tibbs and Simon Phillips appear at Little Big Beat for a Studio Live Session performance of You Cant But You Can with Tibbs on his Xotic five string Jazz.

item.title: This Week in Bass: Bootsy’s Historic Fender, Steve Harris’s New Precision, and Flea’s Fiery Solo Track
item.description: Bootsy Collins’ first Fender Jazz hits auction, Steve Harris gets a new Precision model, and Flea unveils a new solo track. Catch up on this week’s bass news.

item.title: Groove Podcast: Billy Sherwood on Carrying Chris Squire’s Torch and Finding His Own Voice in YES
item.description: Groove Podcast: Billy Sherwood reflects on his musical roots, Chris Squire’s influence, and the evolving creative role he now carries in Yes, from the studio to the stage.

item.title: Evanescence Announces 2026 World Tour, Powered by Bassist Emma Anzai
item.description: Evanescence has announced a 2026 world tour, with bassist Emma Anzai powering the lineup. Amy Lee teases new music, new energy, and a global run.

item.title: North Sea Jazz 2025: Munir Hossn’s Standout Bass Work with Lee Ritenour & Friends
item.description: This North Sea Jazz 2025 set shows Lee Ritenour in top form and highlights Munir Hossn whose commanding bass work adds depth and drive to the entire performance.

item.title: This Tiny Yellow Bass Was Built From 18th-Century Monastery Wood: Meet the Red Bird Mini Gemini
item.description: Red Bird’s Mini Gemini pairs a tiny 23.5" scale with spruce reclaimed from an 18th-century monastery. A bold, fully pro short-scale bass with a huge story.

item.title: Gov’t Mule Announces 2026 Tour as Kevin Scott Drops His All-Star Holiday Spectacular Lineup
item.description: Gov’t Mule announces 2026 tour dates as Kevin Scott prepares for his 10th annual star-studded Funky Holiday Spectacular.

item.title: The Omnific Push Their Dual-Bass Formula Further in the Visually Bold and Rhythm-Heavy “Nodus Tollens” Video
item.description: The Omnific dive deep into their signature dual bass style in the Nodus Tollens video featuring tight interplay on two Dingwall five strings with driving drums.

item.title: Peavey Revives Its Classic Super Festival Series with a 1,200-Watt Bass Rig
item.description: Peavey brings back the Super Festival Series, introducing the 1,200-watt F-1200B bass amp and 610 enclosure with classic tone and updated tech.
